gloss: to win; to gain; to earn through effort

definitions.gloss: to win; to gain; to earn through effort
definitions.explanation: To obtain something valuable through struggle, competition, or sustained effort. Implies that the result was hard-won rather than easily obtained.

examples.japanese: {優勝|ゆうしょう}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}った。
{長|なが}い{交渉|こうしょう}の{末|すえ}、{契約|けいやく}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}った。
examples.english: After long negotiations, we won the contract.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}たちは{長年|ながねん}の{運動|うんどう}を{通|つう}じて{自由|じゆう}と{権利|けんり}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}ってきた。
examples.english: The citizens have won freedom and rights through years of activism.

notes:
USAGE:
{勝|か}ち{取|と}る implies a hard-won achievement. The object is typically something abstract and valuable such as a victory, rights, trust, or a position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}る (to win the championship)
- {信頼|しんらい}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}る (to earn trust)
- {自由|じゆう}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}る (to win freedom)
- {契約|けいやく}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}る (to win a contract)

GRAMMAR:
Godan verb (五段動詞). Transitive. The object takes the particle を.
